# stamp

> SOC 2 readiness you can run: gap reports, audit trails and the SSO plan, as a CLI, an MCP server and skills.

stamp is an agent-native, self-improving compliance employee: the governance and evidence half of B2B trust. It
gap-scans an app for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA audit-readiness and writes a control-mapped gap report, plans the
enterprise SSO program (decide, price, prove), designs the audit trail as a control (tamper-evident, attributed to
an accountable person, exported to a SIEM), scopes access reviews to agent identities, proves whole-pipeline data
residency, runs GDPR and CCPA data-subject requests on their legal clocks, and drafts SIG, CAIQ and VSA questionnaire
answers from a versioned answer base. Its product is judgment: the six `brain/` files are the asset, and the CLI, the
MCP server and the skills route a task to the right entry. It drives Vanta and Drata as tools and never rebuilds a
GRC platform. Powered by Energy. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first.

The boundary: badge owns the auth mechanism (SAML, OIDC and SCIM code, signature validation, event ordering, provider
choice on price, RBAC enforcement at the token); ask stamp for it and it returns a handoff to badge, not code. stamp
owns the posture, the evidence, the SSO program and the attestation package. It never claims "compliant" (only
"audit-ready evidence assembled; attestation pending the auditor"), never accepts an AI-only pen test, never revokes
access by itself, and marks every questionnaire answer as a draft a person must sign.

Run it: `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/stamp stamp --help` (the CLI) and
`npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/stamp stamp-mcp` (the MCP server over stdio: 8 tools and the 6 brain files as
`stamp://brain/{file}` resources). Commands, each with `--json`: `audit <app|path> [--framework soc2|iso27001|hipaa]`,
`sso-plan --target <app> [--acv <n>] [--dry-run]`, `audit-log [--design|--check <path>]`, `access-review [--scope
all|privileged|agents] [--scim]`, `residency [--ask] [--check <path>]`, `dsar --type access|erasure`, `questionnaire
<sig|caiq|vsa|path> [--kb <dir>]`, `advise --on <grc-platform|privacy|pentest|residency|repos>` and `runs [--since
<ts>]`. None needs an account or a key. Every run appends a line with the accountable person to `logs/runs.jsonl`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what stamp does, the boundary gate, how to run every CLI command and MCP tool, the NOT-list, the creeds and the hand-offs to siblings.
- [README.md](README.md): what stamp is, one-step installs for every coding agent, the quick start and the harness grades.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code specifics: the MCP configs, the compliance-lint hook and the sub-agents.
- [HARNESS-OVERRIDES.md](HARNESS-OVERRIDES.md): the per-component done bar for this compliance employee.

## Identity

- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who stamp is: identity, voice, boundaries.
- [identity/BRAND.md](identity/BRAND.md): the name, the tagline, the palette and the landing copy.
- [memory/MEMORY.md](memory/MEMORY.md): the bootstrap: the boundary, the five spine stances, the clocks and cadences, the spec-currency facts.
- [.well-known/agent.json](.well-known/agent.json): the A2A agent card (8 capabilities).

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp/server.ts](src/mcp/server.ts): stamp's own server over stdio with `stamp_audit`, `stamp_sso_plan`, `stamp_audit_log`, `stamp_access_review`, `stamp_residency`, `stamp_dsar`, `stamp_questionnaire` and `stamp_advise`, each wrapping the same library the CLI uses.
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the stranger-safe config: stamp's server from GitHub and context7, no secrets.

## Skills

- [skills/soc2-readiness-audit/SKILL.md](skills/soc2-readiness-audit/SKILL.md): "will we pass SOC 2?": a control-mapped gap report (CC6, CC7, CC8, severity, fix), never a "compliant" badge.
- [skills/enterprise-sso-program/SKILL.md](skills/enterprise-sso-program/SKILL.md): "do we need SSO to close this deal?": the buyer-readiness checklist, the WorkOS wiring plan, the deprovisioning proof and the handoff to badge.
- [skills/audit-trail-as-control/SKILL.md](skills/audit-trail-as-control/SKILL.md): "is our logging audit-ready?": tamper-evident, identity-traced, retained, exported to a SIEM.
- [skills/privacy-dsar-handler/SKILL.md](skills/privacy-dsar-handler/SKILL.md): GDPR and CCPA requests, DPAs and SCCs, residency versus sovereignty, on the legal clocks.
- [skills/questionnaire-from-kb/SKILL.md](skills/questionnaire-from-kb/SKILL.md): SIG, CAIQ and VSA answers from a versioned answer base, and the pen-test tax.
- [skills/grc-platform-advisor/SKILL.md](skills/grc-platform-advisor/SKILL.md): which GRC platform, as a decision with the honest cost.

## Sub-agents and hooks

- [.claude/agents/stamp-soc2-gap-auditor.md](.claude/agents/stamp-soc2-gap-auditor.md): a full SOC 2 control-by-control gap scan of a repository, in a fresh context.
- [.claude/agents/stamp-dsar-handler.md](.claude/agents/stamp-dsar-handler.md): a data-subject request from intake to a routed reply a person signs.
- [.claude/hooks/compliance-lint.js](.claude/hooks/compliance-lint.js): blocks a "compliant" claim, an AI-only pen test, an unapproved revoke or a secret at write time.

## Docs

- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the decision spine: the boundary gate and the eleven jobs.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): 16 named, dated incidents, the source of the golden tasks.
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): P1 to P25, each with how to detect and avoid it.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](brain/OPINIONS.md): O1 to O25, each "always or never, because, source".
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): where the brain is thin or contested.
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): the Vanta, Drata, WorkOS and Cobalt defaults against the alternatives.
- [scripts/acceptance.mjs](scripts/acceptance.mjs): the acceptance bar: the gap report and the SSO plan, 4 assertions, three runs that must match.
- [eval/run.mjs](eval/run.mjs): the eval pyramid: structural checks, 15 golden tasks and an optional model-graded step.
- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract.
- [memory/LEARNINGS.md](memory/LEARNINGS.md): lessons turned into rules.
